frequency_question: How often do major partisan election integrity bills pass at least one chamber of Congress under divided or unified government?
membership_rule: Members are major standalone federal election bills focusing on voter registration verification or ID requirements introduced since 1995. Excluded are provisions tucked into omnibus appropriations or broad post-election certification reform bills.

cases.name: National Voter Registration Act amendments / various early proof-of-citizenship bills

coverage_note: 4 named major legislative efforts covering the specific domain.
known_gaps: Some minor committee-level variants excluded for lack of floor votes.
skeleton: Legislative cycles featuring strict federal voter eligibility bills since 1995.
multiplier: 4 major legislative pushes evaluated for passage in at least one chamber.
validity_reason: Polarization patterns around election administration bills remain stable over multi-year congressional cycles.
